Container.Name: ai-memory
Container.Overview:
ai-memory is persistent, shared memory for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and other MCP clients). It records sessions, builds a searchable wiki of what your agents learned, and hands context from one agent or session to the next. It runs as one container with a SQLite database and needs no API keys; an LLM provider is optional and improves summaries.
Connect clients to http://[server IP]:49374/mcp with the Auth token as a Bearer token. On a client machine with the ai-memory CLI, run: ai-memory install-mcp --client claude-code --auth-token YOUR_TOKEN
Allowed hosts must list every hostname or IP that clients use to reach this server; other Host headers are refused.
The web console (/web) needs HTTPS: put a reverse proxy in front, then set Secure cookie to true, a Root username and an Initial root password. Do not set a root password without HTTPS, because ai-memory then refuses to start on plain HTTP.
Template maintained by repires; ai-memory is developed by Fabio Akita (MIT).

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Host port for MCP clients, hooks and the API (http://[server IP]:PORT/mcp).

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Database, wiki, logs and settings. The container runs as nobody:users (99:100), like other Unraid apps.

Config.Name: Auth token
Config.Description: Required. Every MCP, hook and API request must send it as Authorization: Bearer. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Allowed hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated hostnames and IPs clients use to reach this server. Add your server's LAN IP and name, for example: localhost,127.0.0.1,192.168.1.10,tower.local

Config.Name: LLM provider
Config.Description: Optional. anthropic, openai, gemini, openai-compat (Ollama, OpenRouter, LM Studio...) or opencode. Empty uses rule-based summaries with no API cost.

Config.Name: LLM base URL
Config.Description: For openai-compat, for example http://192.168.1.10:11434/v1 (Ollama) or https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.

Config.Name: LLM model
Config.Description: Optional model name for the chosen provider.

Config.Name: LLM API key
Config.Description: API key for the LLM provider (for anthropic, openai or gemini you can instead add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY as a new variable).

Config.Name: Embedding provider
Config.Description: Optional: openai or voyage, for hybrid (semantic + full-text) search. Empty uses full-text search only.

Config.Name: Embedding API key
Config.Description: API key for the embedding provider.

Config.Name: Secure cookie
Config.Description: Set to true only when the web console is served over HTTPS by a reverse proxy. Required for web login.

Config.Name: Root username
Config.Description: Username for web console login (HTTPS only), for example admin.

Config.Name: Initial root password
Config.Description: HTTPS only: set Secure cookie to true first, or ai-memory will refuse to start. Used once on first start to create the web login (12+ characters); clear it afterwards.
